prompt:
Build an invoice summary. Read carefully: one line item carries a discount that must be applied before tax.

LINE ITEMS (amounts in USD): Widget 120.00; Gadget 80.00; Gizmo 50.00, less a 20% discount on the Gizmo line only.
After discounts, apply sales tax of 8.5% of the discounted subtotal.

Report subtotal (after the discount), tax_amount, and total. Each value MUST be a string with exactly two decimal places, e.g. "12.00". Do not include the line items.
